notes: Details come from MSU Spartan Youth Programs listing. The program page itself (gifted.msu.edu) did not load for the research tool, so check it for 2027 details. Financial aid is listed on sister programs, so ask.
name: MSTL: Math, Science, Technology and Leadership (MSU)
what_you_do: Take two advanced STEM classes and an enrichment class during a one-week summer program on the MSU campus. Choose commuter or residential.
who_can_apply: Strong students in grade 9 or 10 in the 2025-26 school year.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was May 8, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the program page on the MSU gifted programs site. Phone 517-432-2129, email gifted@msu.edu.
